name: amfx-dollar-index-longterm
description: amFX reproduction (30MAR23 p3): US Dollar Index (Trade Weighted Broad) 2006-2023. Uses FRED DTWEXBGS (Nominal Broad USD Index, active). Shows large cyclical swings but no secular downtrend, refuting the dedollarization narrative. Key features: 2008 trough, 2016 peak, stable above average since. Source: Brent Donnelly, Spectra Markets.
source:
# =============================================================================
# AMFX REPRODUCTION: DOLLAR INDEX, LONG TERM (30MAR23 p3)
# =============================================================================
# Brent Donnelly's DXY chart showing no secular dollar decline.
# Uses FRED DTWEXBGS (Nominal Broad USD Index, daily, 2006-present).
# Not identical to ICE DXY but tracks trade-weighted dollar and tells
# the same cyclical story: 2008 trough, 2015-16 peak, stable since.
# DTWEXBGS base = 100 in Jan 2006.
# =============================================================================

# =============================================================================
# DATA: Trade Weighted US Dollar Index from FRED
# =============================================================================

# DTWEXBGS: Nominal Broad US Dollar Index (daily, 2006-01-02 to present)
# Active series, replacement for discontinued DTWEXM
# Shows the same cyclical story: 2008 trough, 2015-16 peak, stable since
dxy_src = economic_indicators(series_id='DTWEXBGS')()
dxy_raw = dxy_src.result
dxy = ffill(dxy_raw)

# Moving averages for structural context
dxy_ma200 = ma(period=200)(dxy)

# Time index
idx = index()

# =============================================================================
# CHART 1: Dollar Index Long-Term (main chart)
# =============================================================================
xy_lines(
    title='Trade Weighted Dollar (2006-2023): Where Is the Secular Decline?',
    category='Dollar Index',
    y_axis_label='Trade Weighted USD Index',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=1,
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='USD Index (DTWEXBGS)', color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='200-Day MA', color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dot)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=96.5, title='Long-Run Average (~96.5)', color=Color.Orange, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ]),
    order=0
)(idx, dxy, dxy_ma200)
